stories.title: Soldier martyred, 17 terrorists killed in intelligence-based operations in Balochistan: ISPR
stories.brief: According to a statement by Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), security forces conducted the IBOs on Nov 1 on the “reported presence of terrorists belonging to Indian proxy Fitna al Hindustan”.

stories.title: Pakistan conducts maiden flight test of locally developed Fa’az air-to-air missile
stories.brief: Read: Pakistan Army successfully test-fires extended-range Fatah-2 hypersonic ballistic missile It added that the successful flight test demonstrated the "technical maturity, innovation and self-reliance" achieved by Pakistan’s defence industry. Earlier this month, the Pakistan Army successfully test-fired the extended-range version of its Fatah-2 hypersonic ballistic missile, which was equipped with advanced navigation and state-of-the-art avionics.

stories.title: Soldier martyred, 17 terrorists killed in Balochistan IBOs: ISPR
stories.brief: Read: Nine terrorists killed in two intelligence-based operations in Balochistan: ISPR The first operation was conducted in the Sanni area of Kachhi district, where security forces foiled an attempt by terrorists to establish a roadblock, killing 10 of them.

stories.title: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after collision
stories.brief: Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel died on Tuesday as a result of injuries he suffered in a sickening collision with FC Andorra's goalkeeper in a Spanish second division match. Andorra also sent their "most sincere condolences" to De Miguel's family, team-mates and Tenerife.

stories.title: Petitions against detention of Sohail Afridi, others referred to PHC CJ for constitution of larger bench
stories.brief: PESHAWAR: A Peshawar High Court (PHC) bench on Tuesday referred multiple petitions challenging the detention of PTI leaders, including Sohail Afridi — the non-functional Khyber Pakhtunkhwa chief minister — to the chief justice for the constitution of a larger bench.

stories.title: PHC sends petitions challenging detentions of Afridi, others to CJ to form larger bench
stories.brief: The petition was filed amid uncertainty over Afridi’s whereabouts following the imposition of emergency and governor’s rule in K-P on October 11, which brought the PTI-led provincial government to an end and transferred its powers to Governor Faisal Karim Kundi.

stories.title: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after on-field collision
stories.brief: Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel dies aged 30 after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match.

stories.title: North Korea denies being behind record $6.3bn Binance hack
stories.brief: US government agencies and cyber analysts have blamed Pyongyang for the record-breaking heist.

stories.title: IHC grants TikToker Anser Mahmood protective bail in wedding stampede case
stories.brief: The Islamabad High Court (IHC) on Tuesday granted protective bail to TikToker Anser Mahmood, alias "Mr Patlu", who was nominated in a case registered over culpable homicide, unlawful assembly, rioting and the death of one person and injuries to several others in a stampede.

stories.title: Gohar refutes reports of Imran welcoming end of K-P government
stories.brief: PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan on Tuesday rejected media reports suggesting that party founder Imran Khan had welcomed the end of the Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa government, saying he had made no such statement during his meeting at Adiala jail with Barrister Salman Safdar.

stories.title: LPG soars in Pakistan, forcing rickshaw drivers to cut meals
stories.brief: Now, with liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) prices surging, he doesn't even make half that. Ali, 33, is among thousands of Pakistani drivers who run their vehicles on LPG, which is sold in cylinders and mainly ​used for cooking and heating.

stories.title: 2 policemen martyred, 1 injured in attack en route to polio duty in KP's Mohmand
stories.brief: The governor noted that polio workers “perform a national duty to protect children and promote a healthy Pakistan” and said the government was responsible for providing security to polio teams. In September, two policemen were martyred as armed assailants fired at a polio vaccination team in Balochistan’s Noshki.

stories.title: Two policemen martyred, one injured in attack on polio team in K-P's Mohmand
stories.brief: Two policemen were martyred, and another was injured when unidentified armed men attacked a polio vaccination team in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa's (K-P) Mohmand district on Tuesday, District Police Officer (DPO) Raza Muhammad Khan said.

stories.title: Food suppliers in UK hit by cyber-attacks after freezers targeted in Europe
stories.brief: Cybersecurity experts say national impact ‘minimal’ but incidents may represent the ‘foothills’ of a wider threat Food suppliers in the UK have been hit by cyber-attacks after hackers raised the temperatures of supermarket freezers across Europe.The UK’s National Cyber Security Centre (NSCS) said it was working with the affected companies but the national impact was…

stories.title: Tenerife footballer Jesús de Miguel dies aged 30 after on-pitch collision
stories.brief: The homicide division of the national police has opened judicial proceedings into a possible involuntary manslaughter, a routine procedure after any death not by natural causes.

stories.title: Irish Olympian Ciara Mageean was a 'talented and inspirational human being'
stories.brief: The former European champion and two-time Olympic runner had been diagnosed with stage four bowel cancer.

stories.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
stories.brief: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.

stories.title: Mining giant joins fight to stop killer toad march across Australia
stories.brief: Rio Tinto is jointly funding a A$28m "toad containment zoe" to protect the Pilbara region.
